name: Supply Landscape
question: Can the company reliably and economically get what it needs — inputs, components, capacity, logistics — and how concentrated/fragile is that chain?

signals.description: Named supplier map + single-source dependencies (baseline). Agent run (effort: high) over filings, news, teardown/trade press; outputSchema = supplier list with confidence per edge.

recipe.query_template: named suppliers and single-source dependencies of {company} from filings, news, and teardown/trade press

signals.description: Supplier distress: financial trouble, capacity cuts, exits; monitored over the supplier Webset

recipe.query_template: {company} supplier financial trouble OR capacity cut OR exit

signals.description: Input-cost trajectory for key commodities/components; news + trade-press monitors per input

recipe.query_template: {company} input costs OR component prices OR commodity costs

signals.description: Logistics/geography risk (chokepoints, sanctioned regions); policy cross-check with F2

recipe.query_template: {company} logistics chokepoints OR sanctioned-region exposure in the supply chain

signals.description: Inventory posture reported in filings (build-up vs shortage)

recipe.query_template: {company} vertical integration OR second source OR dual sourcing

grade_anchors.A: Multi-sourced critical inputs, healthy suppliers, input costs stable/hedged, no chokepoint exposure.
grade_anchors.C: One known single-source dependency with a mitigation plan; input costs pressuring but passable.
grade_anchors.F: Production hostage to a distressed or geopolitically exposed sole supplier; inventory signals contradict management narrative.

false_signals.description: Inventory piling at distributors framed as "demand." Distributor/partner complaints and returns coverage; inventory-vs-revenue divergence from filings extraction.

recipe.query_template: {company} distributor inventory OR returns OR channel complaints

false_signals.description: Announced factories/capacity that never break ground. Announcement-to-execution tracking (§4.4 ledger).

recipe.query_template: {company} announced factory OR capacity expansion construction status

false_signals.description: Inputs bought from entities tied to insiders. Filings extraction + news search on supplier ownership.

recipe.query_template: {company} related party supplier OR insider-linked supplier ownership
